issue: The four local Playwright checks initially could not launch Chromium: libnspr4.so and other system libraries were missing in the restored sandbox. No browser QC output or deployment was produced on the failed attempts.
resolution: Installed the missing Debian Chromium runtime libraries; ldd no longer reports missing shared libraries. The checks must be run again and judged only by their actual new outputs.
limits: System packages and Playwright cache may not persist into a later restored sandbox; simulated browsers do not certify real iOS or WeChat safety.
